title: Ledger unveils $849 Atom device with Solana Seeker app
description: Ledger unveiled the Atom, an Android device with a Ledger OS Secure Mode, priced at $849 for a Founder's Edition and due in summer 2027, with Solana Mobile's Seeker app preinstalled.

title: Brooklyn prosecutors dismantle crypto scam aimed at Russian speakers
description: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 241 domains and 112 servers from a crypto investment scam aimed at Russian speakers, with about $300,000 recovered so far.

title: MSCI adopts rules that could oust Strategy from indexes
description: MSCI adopted a non-operating company methodology effective Nov. 30, with a final list due Nov. 11, that could remove Strategy and other treasury firms from its global indexes.

title: Trezor cuts resellers as Ledger halts sales in seven markets
description: Trezor told resellers their authorizations end Jan. 1, 2027, while Ledger asked distributors in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong to suspend sales during its implant probe.

title: Starknet opens vote on becoming an independent layer 1
description: Starknet opened a seven-day non-binding poll on Oct. 15 asking STRK holders whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer 1, with voting closing Oct. 22.
